examined_formations.title: CHINA_WUXI_11_FTE_SOFTWARE_RECYCLING_CONTROL_TRANSFER_WITH_CLEAN_POST_CONTROL_POSITIVE_REVENUE_PROFIT_BUT_NEGATIVE_OCF_AND_PROJECT_SERVICE
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: On 2025-11-26 the acquisition completed share-transfer registration; the first-largest shareholder, controlling shareholder and actual controller changed.
The acquisition agreement covered 4,999,600 shares, 99.9920% of the company, at RMB0.20 per share for total consideration RMB999,920.
The 2026 H1 period is fully after the completed control transfer and therefore provides a clean post-control operating window.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The 2026 H1 report describes a light-asset software-information business transitioning to software for unmanned recycling vehicles, smart recycling cabinets and a community recycling mini-program.
Current staff at 2026-06-30 total 11 and total assets are about RMB6.8205 million.

The company controls a listed corporate shell, software/customer position and a newly acquired/assembled recycling-software operating position, but continued operating quality must be proven by cashflow rather than the transition narrative.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: 2026 H1 revenue is RMB5.362277 million and net profit is about RMB0.4217 million.
The same H1 data report operating cashflow per share at negative RMB0.0029, so the explicit operating-cashflow sign is negative despite accounting profit.
The current model includes B-side custom software development, annual software fees, maintenance service and a C-side recycling mini-program with transaction commissions/community service fees.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is the closest Scan 117 case because completed near-total control, a clean post-control period, positive revenue/profit, low current headcount and low current asset scale coexist.
The explicit OCF gate still fails. No positive-OCF inference is allowed from positive profit, low assets or revenue growth.
Project customization and maintenance remain current revenue mechanisms, while the newer recurring mini-program/commission route has not been separately evidenced as the cash-generating majority.
economic_signal: Control transaction: 4,999,600 shares / 99.9920% at RMB999,920 total consideration.
2026 H1 net profit approximately RMB0.4217 million.
2026 H1 operating cashflow per share negative RMB0.0029; current FTE 11; current total assets approximately RMB6.8205 million.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The current value surface is software plus recycling workflow/channel access rather than a passive financial shell.
Some revenue mechanisms are potentially recurring, but current disclosures still explicitly include customized development and maintenance.
The company does not yet prove a standardized machine-only external action/settlement rail whose economics remain positive after the control transfer.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_XIAMEN_4_FTE_TRANSITIONAL_PUBLIC_SHELL_WITH_BOUNDED_CONTROL_PRICE_BUT_ZERO_REVENUE_INCOMPLETE_SHARE_DELIVERY_AND_PLANNED_STEEL_MANUFACTURING_INJECTION
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Shanghai Keni Steel Pipe agreed to acquire 6,112,225 shares, 55.54%, for RMB1,405,811.75.

The agreement immediately delegates the corresponding 55.54% voting rights to the acquirer, but the underlying shares remain registered to the seller until restricted shares can be released and transferred.
The 2026 H1 shareholder table still records the seller holding 55.54%, so completed equity delivery is not promoted from contractual control.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Current staff are only four: two management and two administrative employees.
2026-06-30 total assets are approximately RMB0.6597 million.

The acquirer plans to move related special-steel-pipe business, production equipment, personnel, suppliers and customers into the public company and provide financing for production equipment and initial operations.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: 2026 H1 revenue is zero, net profit is negative RMB33,901.20 and operating cashflow is only positive RMB93.88.
The current low headcount is therefore a transitional dormant/light shell state rather than evidence of a proven low-labor revenue engine.
The acquisition plan explicitly anticipates future physical manufacturing resources and personnel, contradicting any inference that the four-person state is the durable delivery model.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: A bounded acquisition price plus four employees is not enough when there is no external revenue or positive profit.
Contractual voting control is real governance influence but the planned share purchase has not completed delivery, so fresh-operator ownership transfer remains incomplete.
The planned injection of steel-pipe manufacturing, equipment and personnel means the current tiny workforce cannot be projected forward as durable founder-light operation.
economic_signal: 2026 H1 revenue RMB0; net loss RMB33,901.20; operating cashflow positive only RMB93.88.
2026-06-30 current FTE 4 and total assets approximately RMB0.6597 million.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The current listed entity is economically near-dormant, while the acquirer intends to use it as a vehicle for a steel-pipe operating business.
Future value would depend on injected manufacturing assets, licenses, personnel, suppliers and customers rather than the current four-person shell.
The control surface is therefore transitional and cannot be treated as a standing machine-operable low-labor cashflow asset.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_FUJIAN_BAMBOO_MATERIALS_TEMPORARY_VOTING_CONTROL_WITH_142_FTE_NEGATIVE_OCF_AND_PHYSICAL_PRODUCTION
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: On 2026-05-19 prior voting delegation was terminated and 56,755,678 shares, 20.9994% of voting rights, were irrevocably delegated to Pan Donghan.
Pan Donghan became controlling shareholder and actual controller through the delegation, which runs only from 2026-05-19 to 2027-05-18.
No underlying share purchase or fresh third-party control consideration is evidenced by this control-change mechanism.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Current H1 staff total 142: 65 technical, 44 administrative, 17 sales, 11 management and 5 finance.
2026-06-30 assets are RMB322.4472 million and liabilities RMB266.7423 million.
The principal operating subsidiary produces bamboo-plastic materials and the H1 report cites added production-equipment investment.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: 2026 H1 revenue is RMB55.4790 million, but net profit is negative and operating cashflow is negative RMB18.1895 million.
Current staffing expanded from 118 to 142 during H1.
The report states that production-equipment investment increased, directly contradicting a machine-light low-capital interpretation.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The controller change is governance-real but is a time-limited voting-right delegation rather than a reproducible independent purchase of the decisive ownership position.
The H1 reporting period straddles the May 19 control change, so H1 economics are not relabeled as a clean post-control continuity period.
Regardless of time-window ambiguity, current 142 FTE, physical production, large assets and negative OCF independently kill the Scan 117 low-labor boundary.
economic_signal: 2026 H1 operating cashflow negative RMB18.1895 million and net profit negative.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The scarce operating position is a physical bamboo-materials production organization rather than a portable machine-control right.
Control is temporarily delegated rather than acquired through a bounded fresh-operator ownership transaction.
Current labor, production equipment, borrowing and physical manufacturing dominate the economics.

excluded_observations: Scan 060-116 formations and their primary discovery signals were excluded from Scan 117 primary formation selection.

Completed-control industrial targets with obviously large manufacturing organizations were not deepened once current low-FTE evidence already failed unless they added a distinct control-mechanism falsifier.
No job, gig, RFQ, procurement or asset-marketplace feed was used as the discovery ontology.
